summary: Authored comprehensive blameless incident postmortem for INC-2024-0315-01 (Auth Bypass & Unauthorized Deletion) meeting full Google SRE / Amazon architectural standards.
evidence: Authored complete postmortem document in progress/postmortem-inc-2024-0315-01.md.
Drafted 10-point minute-by-minute timeline (14:22 UTC exploitation start through 15:09 UTC full mitigation and recovery) with exact timestamps and forensic actions.

Identified technical root cause in requireAuth middleware falsy check (if (!authHeader)) and distinguished it from 4 systemic contributing factors (absence of negative tests in CI, lack of destructive rate limiting, absence of deletion velocity alarms, permissive gateway header forwarding).

Quantified business and operational impact: 47 minutes total duration, 10-minute active attack window, 8 tenants affected, 12 links deleted, 0 permanent data loss (100% recovered via PostgreSQL WAL PITR), and 100% uptime maintained for public redirects.

Formulated 4 structural, owner-backed remediation items with strict deadlines: 1) CI auth header fuzzing, 2) WAF edge header sanitization, 3) destructive operation rate limiting, and 4) velocity-based deletion alarms.
Documented lessons learned across what went well, what went poorly, and where the team got lucky.
